extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians and authors submitting or browsing arXiv mathematics categories
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for classifying or browsing mathematics submissions on arXiv by subject category; lists each math.* category and the topical scope that belongs there. Useful for authors deciding where to submit and for readers searching by subject area.

rubrics_metrics.name: math.AC - Commutative Algebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Commutative rings, modules, ideals, homological algebra, computational aspects, invariant theory, connections to algebraic geometry and combinatorics

rubrics_metrics.name: math.AG - Algebraic Geometry
rubrics_metrics.description: Algebraic varieties, stacks, sheaves, schemes, moduli spaces, complex geometry, quantum cohomology

rubrics_metrics.name: math.AP - Analysis of PDEs
rubrics_metrics.description: Existence and uniqueness, boundary conditions, linear and non-linear operators, stability, soliton theory, integrable PDE's, conservation laws, qualitative dynamics

rubrics_metrics.name: math.AT - Algebraic Topology
rubrics_metrics.description: Homotopy theory, homological algebra, algebraic treatments of manifolds

rubrics_metrics.name: math.CA - Classical Analysis and ODEs
rubrics_metrics.description: Special functions, orthogonal polynomials, harmonic analysis, ODE's, differential relations, calculus of variations, approximations, expansions, asymptotics

rubrics_metrics.name: math.CO - Combinatorics
rubrics_metrics.description: Discrete mathematics, graph theory, enumeration, combinatorial optimization, Ramsey theory, combinatorial game theory

rubrics_metrics.name: math.CT - Category Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Enriched categories, topoi, abelian categories, monoidal categories, homological algebra

rubrics_metrics.name: math.CV - Complex Variables
rubrics_metrics.description: Holomorphic functions, automorphic group actions and forms, pseudoconvexity, complex geometry, analytic spaces, analytic sheaves

rubrics_metrics.name: math.DG - Differential Geometry
rubrics_metrics.description: Complex, contact, Riemannian, pseudo-Riemannian and Finsler geometry, relativity, gauge theory, global analysis

rubrics_metrics.name: math.DS - Dynamical Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Dynamics of differential equations and flows, mechanics, classical few-body problems, iterations, complex dynamics, delayed differential equations

rubrics_metrics.name: math.FA - Functional Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Banach spaces, function spaces, real functions, integral transforms, theory of distributions, measure theory

rubrics_metrics.name: math.GM - General Mathematics
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathematical material of general interest, topics not covered elsewhere

rubrics_metrics.name: math.GN - General Topology
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuum theory, point-set topology, spaces with algebraic structure, foundations, dimension theory, local and global properties

rubrics_metrics.name: math.GR - Group Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Finite groups, topological groups, representation theory, cohomology, classification and structure

rubrics_metrics.name: math.GT - Geometric Topology
rubrics_metrics.description: Manifolds, orbifolds, polyhedra, cell complexes, foliations, geometric structures

rubrics_metrics.name: math.HO - History and Overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Biographies, philosophy of mathematics, mathematics education, recreational mathematics, communication of mathematics, ethics in mathematics

rubrics_metrics.name: math.IT - Information Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: math.IT is an alias for cs.IT. Covers theoretical and experimental aspects of information theory and coding.

rubrics_metrics.name: math.KT - K-Theory and Homology
rubrics_metrics.description: Algebraic and topological K-theory, relations with topology, commutative algebra, and operator algebras

rubrics_metrics.name: math.LO - Logic
rubrics_metrics.description: Logic, set theory, point-set topology, formal mathematics

rubrics_metrics.name: math.MG - Metric Geometry
rubrics_metrics.description: Euclidean, hyperbolic, discrete, convex, coarse geometry, comparisons in Riemannian geometry, symmetric spaces

rubrics_metrics.name: math.MP - Mathematical Physics
rubrics_metrics.description: math.MP is an alias for math-ph. Articles in this category focus on areas of research that illustrate the application of mathematics to problems in physics, develop mathematical methods for such applications, or provide mathematically rigorous formulations of existing physical theories. Submissions to math-ph should be of interest to both physically oriented mathematicians and mathematically oriented physicists; submissions which are primarily of interest to theoretical physicists or to mathematicians should probably be directed to the respective physics/math categories

rubrics_metrics.name: math.NA - Numerical Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Numerical algorithms for problems in analysis and algebra, scientific computation

rubrics_metrics.name: math.NT - Number Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Prime numbers, diophantine equations, analytic number theory, algebraic number theory, arithmetic geometry, Galois theory

rubrics_metrics.name: math.OA - Operator Algebras
rubrics_metrics.description: Algebras of operators on Hilbert space, C^*-algebras, von Neumann algebras, non-commutative geometry

rubrics_metrics.name: math.OC - Optimization and Control
rubrics_metrics.description: Operations research, linear programming, control theory, systems theory, optimal control, game theory

rubrics_metrics.name: math.PR - Probability
rubrics_metrics.description: Theory and applications of probability and stochastic processes: e.g. central limit theorems, large deviations, stochastic differential equations, models from statistical mechanics, queuing theory

rubrics_metrics.name: math.QA - Quantum Algebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantum groups, skein theories, operadic and diagrammatic algebra, quantum field theory

rubrics_metrics.name: math.RA - Rings and Algebras
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-commutative rings and algebras, non-associative algebras, universal algebra and lattice theory, linear algebra, semigroups

rubrics_metrics.name: math.RT - Representation Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Linear representations of algebras and groups, Lie theory, associative algebras, multilinear algebra

rubrics_metrics.name: math.SG - Symplectic Geometry
rubrics_metrics.description: Hamiltonian systems, symplectic flows, classical integrable systems

rubrics_metrics.name: math.SP - Spectral Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Schrodinger operators, operators on manifolds, general differential operators, numerical studies, integral operators, discrete models, resonances, non-self-adjoint operators, random operators/matrices

rubrics_metrics.name: math.ST - Statistics Theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Applied, computational and theoretical statistics: e.g. statistical inference, regression, time series, multivariate analysis, data analysis, Markov chain Monte Carlo, design of experiments, case studies
